newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Germany's Bayernwerk eyes Swiss utilities.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Bayernwerk eyes Swiss utilities.

text.p: German electricity company Bayernwerk AG said on Thursday it was interested in two Swiss utilities, Aare-Tessin AG fuer Elektrizitaet (Atel) and Elektrowatt.
Bayernwerk management board chairman Otto Majewski said his company was in talks with Swiss bank UBS on the purchase of Atel.
UBS wanted to sell 48 percent of its 76 percent stake in Motor-Columbus AG, which in turn owns 56 percent of Atel, Majewski said, speaking at a news conference in Budapest.
Bayernwerk was also interested in buying the electricity business of Elektrowatt, Majewski said.
Majewski said CS Holding was interested in selling its share stake of about 44 percent in Elektrowatt. He added that only Elektrowatt's energy business would be attractive for Bayernwerk.
Bayernwerk is a subsidiary of German diversified group Viag AG.
